title: Vietnam Trip Cost per day & week - 2025 Travel Budget
paragraphs: Vietnam is a popular destination for budget travelers and backpackers, offering affordable options for accommodation, food, and activities. With its delicious and cheap street food, coupled with an abundance of budget-friendly accommodations, it’s easy to have an enjoyable time in Vietnam without breaking the bank.
